caseName: Alatex Construction Service, Inc. v. Crawford
caseNameFull: ALATEX CONSTRUCTION SERVICE, INC. v. CRAWFORD
attorneys: Howard W. Lenfant for Community Finance Service, Inc., appellant., Conrad Meyer III for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
